# International entry requirements

Gain entry into your chosen UNSW degree.

[Apply now](https://apply.unsw.edu.au/)

![Students walking outside the Red Center, UNSW Kensignton.](https://www.unsw.edu.au/content/dam/images/unsw-wide/general/students/2020-12-ug-guide/2020-12-ug-day-2-sh07/2020-12-09-UG-Guide-2022-D2-%20SH07%201269.cropimg.width=335.crop=video.jpg)

### Entry includes academic and English language requirements

There are different entry requirements to consider depending on what you want to study. Entry requirements range from prior study to your final high school exam scores, ensuring you’re equipped to succeed in your chosen degree.

### Academic entry requirements

- Completed a recognised qualification











Before applying for a degree, you should first check that we recognise your secondary/tertiary education qualification. This can include:



1. Secondary education qualifications
2. Higher education study
3. Diploma and other post-secondary studies
4. Foundation studies

Visit our [Accepted Qualifications](https://www.unsw.edu.au/study/how-to-apply/accepted-qualifications) page for detailed information on what qualifications we accept.

##### **Postgraduate study**

For postgraduate study, you generally need to have completed an undergraduate degree at university level. Check the entry requirements tab of your chosen degree for detailed information.

[Search degrees](https://www.unsw.edu.au/study/find-a-degree-or-course)

- Meet the required scores for your chosen degree



















You will need to meet academic entry scores for your chosen UNSW degree. International direct entry scores are listed on each degree page.








[Search degrees](https://www.unsw.edu.au/study/find-a-degree-or-course)







[Entry requirements table](https://www.unsw.edu.au/content/dam/pdfs/future-students/2027-int-ug-entry-table.pdf)


### English language requirements

Provide evidence that your English language ability meets our requirements.

Submit results from an accepted English language test taken in the last two years prior to starting at UNSW. Read more on our English language requirements page.

[Read more](https://www.unsw.edu.au/study/how-to-apply/english-language-requirements)

## What if I don't meet the requirements?

Before applying for a degree, you should first check that we recognise your secondary/tertiary education qualification. This can include:

- Secondary education qualifications
- Higher education study
- Diploma and other post-secondary studies
- Foundation Studies

College provides pathway options to help you study your preferred UNSW degree.

[Admission Pathways](https://www.unsw.edu.au/study/how-to-apply/international/admission-pathways)
